deviations.description: Cord rule C has a threshold offset of about 3 Gy. Layer-1 unit 8 (the cord_floor - cord_lim detector) has bias -0.5009, so it stays off until cord_floor exceeds cord_lim by about 2.7 Gy, and the score only becomes positive at a gap of about 3 Gy (somewhat more at some inputs). Requests whose cord goal is below the anatomical floor by less than about 3 Gy, with no other escalation trigger, are sent to automated planning instead of being escalated.
deviations.condition: (cord_floor - cord_lim > 0) and (cord_floor - cord_lim < 2.8) and (cov <= cap) and (missing == 0) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > 0.1) and (cov > mand_lim))
